subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “At the start of the year, Class 807 made a class promise.”?
options: Students added basketball games, music practice, library days, and reminders to water the class plant.
Instead of rules written by the teacher, students wrote what kind of class they wanted.
Instead of giving only a punishment, the teacher asked the class to test AI answers.
A teacher wanted everyone visible, but students gave different reasons.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students added basketball games, music practice, library days, and reminders to water the class plant.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Instead of rules written by the teacher, students wrote what kind of class they wanted.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Instead of giving only a punishment, the teacher asked the class to test AI answers.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A teacher wanted everyone visible, but students gave different reasons.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Instead of rules written by the teacher, students wrote what kind of class they wanted.」，答案為「Instead of rules written by the teacher, students wrote what kind of class they wanted.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Instead of rules written by the teacher, students wrote what kind of class they wanted.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
